en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large medieval hilltop castle complex surrounded by dense trees and orchards. The castle features multiple connected buildings with steep gabled roofs and a prominent round tower with a crenellated top. At the top in red type it is labeled with the place and castle name; there is also vertical red printing along the left edge with publisher information and a date.
